VaultBackup.title: VaultBackup
VaultBackup.description: Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM encrypted TOTP vault stored per user. Never contains plaintext secrets or recovery passwords.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

encryptedPayload.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext and authentication tag of the serialized TOTP vault.

vaultIv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte random AES-GCM nonce for encryptedPayload.

wrappedVek.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM wrapped 256-bit Vault Encryption Key (VEK) encrypted using the PBKDF2-derived KEK.

wrapIv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte random AES-GCM nonce for wrappedVek.

kdfSalt.description: Base64-encoded cryptographically random salt for PBKDF2.

backupVersion.description: Monotonically increasing backup version used for optimistic concurrency and conflict detection.

lastDeviceId.description: Anonymous random installation UUID of the device that wrote this version.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud vault was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest vault backup (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/vault/{vaultId}.description: Zero-knowledge encrypted authenticator vault document at users/{uid}/vault/main.
